title: Rabbi Ada of Yafo
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Taanit 9b mentions him explaining Rabbi Yehudah’s reasoning. In Megillah 16b he says that the names of Haman’s ten sons and the words “and the ten” must be recited in one breath. The Rif and Rosh read Rabbi Abba of Yafo.
We also find Rabbi Chiya, son of Rabbi Ada of Yafo, in Bereshit Rabbah 38:13 and Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7.

notes.text: The Rif and Rosh form is Abba, whereas the supplied heading and the son’s patronym use Ada.
The consulted Gemara names Rav Ada of Yafo. The consulted Rif and Rosh texts give Rabbi Abba of Yafo. All three give the instruction to say the names and “and the ten” in one breath.
